description.value: Hightop Pizza is a Detroit-style pizza restaurant in North Vancouver, BC. Detroit-style pies are known for their thick, rectangular focaccia-like crust, crispy cheese-laced edges, and sauce layered on top — a distinctive regional American style with a growing fanbase. It would make a hearty refuelling stop for cyclists on the North Shore.
